title: Elizabeth Rauscher's ONI grant and her Berkeley archive

tellings.quote: She passed away, but they got like this huge grant from the the ONI. And I was like, you know, looking everywhere to try to find documents, she has a huge archive at Berkeley of all of her research, and I I had someone go there and look, and we couldn't find anything,

plain: A scientist named Elizabeth Rauscher and her colleagues are said to have received "this huge grant" from the Office of Naval Intelligence, or ONI, the Navy's intelligence arm, sometime between the 1970s and early 1980s. A researcher named Greg Malatzi tells Michels this without naming a source. He says Rauscher, who has since died, left "a huge archive at Berkeley of all of her research", and that he sent someone to search it for papers on the grant, but "we couldn't find anything." If it is true, it would mean Navy intelligence paid for her unusual research.
